proposedchanges.title: Trump Pardons David Francis Rowland
proposedchanges.description_medium: On January 13, 2021, President Donald Trump pardoned David Francis Rowland. The Justice Department's clemency list associates Rowland with a South Carolina federal case, two counts labeled federal enforcement procedure, and a two-year probation sentence imposed in 1997. The record does not explain the conduct behind the counts or why he received clemency.
proposedchanges.description_long: Keep this record in needs_context until a case-specific source explains the conduct behind the federal-enforcement-procedure counts and provides the clemency rationale. Remove the repeated sentences about what the source list does not provide.

evidencebasis: The latest descriptions identify the pardon date, South Carolina court, offense label, and two-year probation sentence. They do not provide the conduct behind the counts or a reason for clemency.
notes: The DOJ source URL is retained. The available facts support a concise pardon entry but not a contextual long explanation.
